fact: Ecofin Agency reports the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy (SNIA 2030) was adopted in March 2025, with a projected budget above 1 trillion CFA francs through 2030.
Xinhua reports that Cote d'Ivoire's digital transition ministry signed three memoranda with the private sector on 19 May 2025 to speed implementation of the existing National AI Strategy (SNIA).

CIO Mag reports, from an interview with the ministry's director of innovation, that the national AI strategy was officially handed over (remise) on 13 March 2025, with a planned budget of over 1,000 billion FCFA for 2025-2030 and a National AI Agency to be created first; no adoption is stated.
The director of the national computing centre refers to Cote d'Ivoire's Stratégie nationale de l'intelligence artificielle as a strategy carried over 5 years, which the centre's AI hub is to launch.
